segments.text_en: Cosmic decision and divine decree to build Eninnu
evidence: It was time to decide destinies in heaven and on earth
Lagash had raised the head towards heaven in large 'me'
Enlil looked righteously upon lord Ningirsu
I will make the 'me' of Eninnu emerge in heaven and on earth

segments.text_en: Enigmatic nocturnal dream and decision to consult Nanshe
evidence: It was then, in a 'dark goat', that towards his king, on the lord Ningirsu, Gudea looked
“Build his house!,” he ordered him
Gudea, his 'heart' is distant, counseled about the message
Of what my 'dark goat' has revealed to me, its 'heart' I did not know
Let me bring my dream to her, to my mother

segments.text_en: Pilgrimage to Bagara and prayer to Ningirsu
evidence: Did he not set foot on his barge?
After reaching Bagara—house hanging over the river, he sacrificed bread, he poured out cold water
Hero, you spoke to me, let me do it right for you, Ningirsu, let me build your house for you
From Gudea, his offering and his prayer, his king, the lord Ningirsu, received from him

segments.text_en: Supplication and appeal to mother Gatumdu
evidence: The governor set up his bed in the house of Gatumdu
I am a no-mother-haver, you are my mother
may your good Utukku go in front of me, may your good Lamma follow me on my path
His lady, the offering and the prayer, Shiny-Gatumdu received from Gudea

segments.text_en: Arrival at Nina and recitation of the dream to Nanshe
evidence: He went to Nanše, he prayed to her
Inside the dream there was one man, his greatness was like heaven, his greatness was like the earth
She held a stylus of purified silver in the hand. She had the tablet of the stars on her lap
Secondly, it was a hero, he bent the arm, he held a lapis writing board in the hand
the brick of deciding destinies was placed in the mold for me

segments.text_en: Nanshe interprets dream symbols and gives ritual instructions
evidence: My shepherd, let me, me interpret your dream for you
it is surely my brother Ningirsu. ‘Build his shrine, the Eninnu!’ He ordered you
That is surely Nisaba, my sister
it is Nindubba, placing the house on the plan of the house
Let me give you instructions, let my instructions be heeded

segments.text_en: Preparation and presentation of sacred gifts to Ningirsu
evidence: The righteous shepherd Gudea learnt big, and now he will perform big
He broke the seal of his treasure house, he brought out wood
He fashioned his beloved emblem for him, he wrote his name on it
With his beloved harp, 'dragon of the land'... to his king, lord Ningirsu... he enters

segments.text_en: Purification and direct prayer for a definitive sign
evidence: He flattened the hills, he returned accusations. He removed the spittle from the dagger
Juniper, the pure tree of the mountain he placed on the fire
he went to him in ‘ubšu-ukkina’, he greeted him
Ningirsu, I will build your house for you, (but) my sign is my not
I, what can I learn from you?

segments.text_en: Ningirsu's epiphany and promise of cosmic abundance
evidence: Gudea, I will surely give you the sign of the building of my house
I, the lord, have made my house, the Eninnu, bigger than a mountain
With the founding of my house, may abundance arrive
I will build the house for you at day, at night I will let it grow for you
On that day (when) your arm is touched with fire, I will teach you my sign

segments.text_en: Omen verification, moral reform, and site purification
evidence: Gudea rose, it was a dream. He is afraid, it was a dream
He struck the hand into the goat, his goat is good
A mother does not accuse a son, accusations, a son to his mother does not speak
The governor cleansed the city, he spun it with fire
he purifies the platform for him

segments.text_en: Civic levy and mobilization of international tribute
evidence: On that day, the governor arranged a levy in his land, in the totality of all of his lands
in the ‘tribe’ of Ningirsu, he made a levy for him
Elam came to him from Elam. Susa came to him from Susa
Magan and Meluhha, from their land, submitted to him
they assembled for Gudea in his city Girsu

segments.text_en: Expeditions and gathering of timber, stone, and metals
evidence: To the land of cedar, where no man enters, for Gudea, the Lord Ningirsu made way for him
He cut down its cedars with the great axe
From the cedar mountains, cedar beams, from the cypress mountain, cypress beams
From Kimaš, the mountain of copper... the copper he excavated there
Purified silver is being brought down for Gudea from its mountain

segments.text_en: Ground survey, divine planning, and first brick molding
evidence: Enki made the plan of the house right for him
the field was right, he measured it, he placed sticks on its border
Gudea placed clay in the mold. The cultic order emerged
He shook the mold, he threw the brick to dry
He placed the brick, he brought the mold into the house, he lifted the brick from the mold

segments.text_en: Final divine omens and the seven foundation blessings
evidence: he stretched his hand in the goat, his goat was good
Enki places the foundation of the house, Nanše, the daughter of Eridu cared for the omen taking
he placed the foundation, the wall touched the ground, he gave a blessing
For the second (time) did he not give a blessing in the house?
For the seventh (time) did he not give a blessing in the house?

segments.text_en: Temple construction and dedication of commemorative stelas
evidence: They make the house grow like a mountain. They make it float in the middle of the heaven like a cloud
The governor built the house, he made it grow, he made it grow like a large mountain
His stone erected in the mighty courtyard... as name of that stone he named
His stone erected in Kasurra... as name of that stone he named
His stone erected in front of Šugalam... as name of that stone he named

segments.text_en: Installation of mythical warrior trophies and guardians
evidence: Gudea made Ningirsu’s house go out from the cloud like Utu, made it grow like a mountain of Lapis
At the war-door of the inner room, where the weapon hang, Sagar, the hero, the six headed ram, he seizes there
At the frightening place facing the city, the seven heroes he seizes there
Because they are dead warriors, he placed their mouths at the libation place
(and) their names, in the midst of the gods, Gudea, governor of Lagash, made them emerge

segments.text_en: Temple completion, provisions fitting, and hymn of praise
evidence: The fear of Eninnu, on all the lands, like a garment, it covered
The house, founded by Anu with purified silver, decorated with good perfume, rising in heavenly brilliance
From the cow pen, oil deliveries, milk deliveries, From the mighty oven, large cakes
The house (was) built in joy by its king. Ningešzida built it on a big place. Gudea, governor of Lagash, placed its foundation
For the restoration of Eninnu Ningirsu be praised! The building of the house of Ningirsu, this is the middle of the praise
